title: Florida vacant-land prices by county and city
description: Median price per acre of arm's-length vacant-land sales of 1+ acre, with the sale count and the months the sales span, for every Florida county and city market page on groundworkmap.com. A null median: fewer than 5 own sales (the page then shows a wider market's figure, labeled).
method: Median of arm's-length vacant-land sales of 1+ acre, USD per acre. Latest arm's-length sale per vacant parcel; one deed of several parcels counts once. $/acre over 1+ acre sales, per lot under 1 acre. Non-ag sales above 3× assessed value excluded (built on since the Jan 1 roll). Each county's 12 months end with its latest fully recorded month; Florida and region totals end with the month most counties have recorded.

field_notes.n_sales: arm's-length vacant-land sales of 1+ acre in the sales window: the sales behind the median
field_notes.sale_date_min/sale_date_max: the months the page prints beside the figures: the span of all the place's vacant-land sales in the window (lots included), or the statewide sales window when the place has none. A row with n_sales 0 still carries the range; it is not the dates of sales behind n_sales.
field_notes.median_usd_per_lot/n_lot_sales: the median price and the count of vacant-lot sales under 1 acre

terms: Free to copy, share and adapt, including commercially, under CC BY 4.0: credit "Groundwork (groundworkmap.com)" and link the row's page_url or this file. The license covers these files only; the rest of the site and the map stay under https://groundworkmap.com/terms. Aggregates of public records, not an appraisal. Groundwork is not affiliated with any county property appraiser or government.

Latest arm's-length sale per vacant parcel; one deed of several parcels counts once. $/acre over 1+ acre sales, per lot under 1 acre. Non-ag sales above 3× assessed value excluded (built on since the Jan 1 roll). Each county's 12 months end with its latest fully recorded month; Florida and region totals end with the month most counties have recorded.
